articles.title: Indo-Russian consortium bags Indian Railways' ₹1,100 cr track upkeep contract
articles.summary: An Indo-Russian consortium secured a significant ₹1,100 crore contract from Indian Railways for supplying and maintaining critical track maintenance equipment. This deal is vital for modernizing India's railway infrastructure and improving operational efficiency. The consortium's bid was 35% lower than competitors, demonstrating cost-effective international collaboration for national development and infrastructure enhancement.

articles.title: The next NATO crisis could begin on the seabed
articles.summary: Modern conflict is evolving beyond conventional missile strikes and attack aircraft, the article highlights. It likely discusses the multifaceted nature of contemporary warfare, encompassing domains such as cyber, space, and information operations, alongside traditional force projection. This broader understanding of complex security challenges is vital for defence aspirants to comprehend future strategic landscapes.

articles.title: Green Lantern #33 Preview: 600th-Issue New Costume Extravaganza
articles.summary: Green Lantern #33 marks a significant milestone, celebrating 600 issues within the popular DC Comics universe. The storyline sees Kyle Rayner taking on critical Earth-based responsibilities, while veteran hero Hal Jordan faces his most formidable test yet. The issue also introduces updated costumes for key characters, indicating fresh developments in this long-running science fiction series.

articles.title: 1965 WAR: BATTLE OF BURKI
articles.summary: This article commemorates the Battle of Burki, a glorious engagement fought between India and Pakistan on September 10, 1965. Dedicated to the memory of the brave soldiers who participated, it underscores a crucial chapter in India's defence history. Aspirants can learn about the strategic significance and courage displayed in such key military conflicts, reflecting on the sacrifices made for the nation.

articles.title: IAF staffer arrested for spying for Pakistani handlers, sharing sensitive information
articles.summary: Rajasthan Intelligence arrested a civilian employee at an Indian Air Force station in Assam for allegedly spying. The individual is accused of sharing sensitive defence information with Pakistani handlers. This incident underscores critical national security vulnerabilities and the constant need for vigilance within military establishments, highlighting the importance of robust counter-intelligence frameworks to protect India's strategic assets and personnel from external threats.

articles.title: Defence research stays underfunded
articles.summary: Ministry of Defence data indicates India's defence research expenditure, mainly by DRDO, has grown less than headline figures suggest. Actual spending on crucial R&D remains understated, highlighting a potential gap in indigenous innovation and capability development. This discrepancy in defence spending is critical for national security and self-reliance, a key area for SSB aspirants to understand regarding India's strategic preparedness.
